nodes.name: Housing support needed; application required
nodes.description: A low-income household needs housing support, and the benefit is only available when an application is made (no direct on-the-spot payment).

evidence.quote: Most benefits provided by Kela are generally available on application only.
Kela provides assistance with housing for low-income households by paying housing allowances.

nodes.name: Submit housing allowance application online (OmaKela)
nodes.description: The applicant applies for the benefit online through Kela's OmaKela e-service (hakeminen OmaKelassa).

evidence.quote: You can apply for most benefits, submit documents supporting your application and report changes online using Kela’s OmaKela e-service.
Useimpia etuuksia voi hakea verkossa Kelan asiointipalvelu OmaKelassa.

nodes.name: Submit supporting documents (liitteet)
nodes.description: The applicant sends documents that support the application through OmaKela.

evidence.quote: You can apply for most benefits, submit documents supporting your application and report changes online using Kela’s OmaKela e-service.

nodes.name: Check application status in OmaKela
nodes.description: The applicant looks up the status of their application in OmaKela.

evidence.quote: You can also check the status of your application and payment dates.
tarkistaa hakemuksesi tilanteen ja tuen maksupäivät

nodes.name: Pay housing allowance (asumistuki)
nodes.description: Kela supports low-income households' housing by paying the housing allowance.

evidence.quote: Kela provides assistance with housing for low-income households by paying housing allowances.
Kela tukee pienituloisten asumista maksamalla asumistukea.

nodes.name: Check payment dates in OmaKela
nodes.description: The recipient looks up the benefit payment dates in OmaKela.

evidence.quote: You can also check the status of your application and payment dates.
tarkistaa hakemuksesi tilanteen ja tuen maksupäivät

nodes.name: Report changes online (OmaKela)
nodes.description: The applicant or recipient reports changes to Kela online through OmaKela.

evidence.quote: You can apply for most benefits, submit documents supporting your application and report changes online using Kela’s OmaKela e-service.

nodes.name: Contact Kela customer service for help
nodes.description: An applicant who needs help calls Kela's customer service number or visits a Kela service point (palvelupiste).

evidence.quote: If you need help, you can call Kela’s customer service number or visit a Kela service point.
Jos tarvitset neuvoja, soita Kelan puhelinpalveluun tai tule käymään palvelupisteessä.

nodes.name: Give guidance by phone or at service point
nodes.description: Kela customer service helps the customer by phone or at a Kela service point.

evidence.quote: If you need help, you can call Kela’s customer service number or visit a Kela service point.
